cases.compatibility: Long-term ownership and cost discipline fit. Share reduction after bullish letter need not contradict it; portfolio sizing, risk or account flows unknown.
cases.independent_lesson: Turn a persuasive letter into measurable cash-flow accounting and compare each request with actual management actions. Do not infer activist causality or return from chronology.

chain.evidence: Proposed valuation, capital commitment and sponsor terms; promotional thesis before closing.
Forward growth and adjusted-profit projections with peer valuation comparisons.
Completed combination; expected Nasdaq trading December 2.
Manager common and warrant lines; not complete original sponsored investment.
Common-stock line absent, warrant line remains; cannot prove full group exit.
Profitability improved materially, but full-year adjusted EBITDA still negative; original forecasts require metric bridges.

cases.adverse_classification: Forecast/valuation-risk counterexample, not a verified all-account Altimeter realized loss. Original forecast and later reported full-year profitability diverge directionally; exact miss magnitude is not computed without definition reconciliation.
cases.compatibility: Founder-led platform partnership remains compatible with later improving business. Promoted optimistic forecasts and valuation illustrate risks absent from a persona-only narrative. A public common-line disappearance does not establish sponsor/PIPE liquidation or hypocrisy.
cases.independent_lesson: Score economics by security class and reporting definition; require downside valuation and cash runway rather than relying on long-term alignment statements.

return_verification.public_common_2022_adverse_price_proxy: Q3 2022 reported common value/shares implies about $2.63, versus original deck PIPE price $10.00. Security-price proxy only, not Altimeter matched-lot or total investment return.

thought_position_audit.finding: A supportive Meta letter accompanied an existing stake; subsequent lower shares do not identify intent.
2021 growth/peer valuation promotion versus 2022 ROI/FCF discipline suggests regime-sensitive underwriting; different businesses/securities prevent a blanket contradiction finding.
Private growth investments, sponsor economics, hedge exposures and private/public net returns are not reconstructed.
